items.title: A quasi-affine scheme becomes an affine space after an affine base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a quasi-affine scheme X there are an integer n and a morphism T -> X from an affine scheme such that over every affine scheme X' over X the base change is an affine space over X' (statement lines 2738-2744). The proof (proof lines 2746-2802) presents X as the complement of finitely many equations, builds T from those equations, and verifies the base change identification by exhibiting explicit mutually inverse isomorphisms. H3: an original explicit construction with a verification by formulae, written out in full.
